title: Appointment Series Scheduling Standards by Visit Format
content:
Every Appointment Series at Piedmont Motion Physical Therapy is held in one of six visit formats, and the format fixes the length of each appointment, how many standing appointments the series may carry each week, how long the series may run and how far ahead and in what batches its appointments are booked. The schedule below is the reference for all six formats.

## Schedule A — slot length, weekly frequency and series length

| Visit format | Length of one appointment | Standing appointments per week (minimum to maximum) | Maximum series length from the start date | Same weekday and time held for the whole series |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | 30 minutes | 1 to 3 | 8 weeks | No |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 45 minutes | 1 to 3 | 8 weeks | Yes |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 60 minutes | 1 to 3 | 8 weeks | Yes |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 45 minutes | 1 to 2 | 6 weeks | Yes |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 60 minutes | 1 to 2 | 8 weeks | Yes |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 45 minutes | 2 to 3 | 12 weeks | Yes |

## Schedule B — booking horizon and booking batch

| Visit format | Booking horizon (calendar days from the booking date) | Maximum appointments in one booking |
|---|---|---|
| Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series | 42 | 12 |
| Standard 45-Minute Visit Series | 42 | 12 |
| Extended 60-Minute Visit Series | 42 | 12 |
| Aquatic Therapy Visit Series | 28 | 8 |
| Specialty One-on-One Visit Series | 56 | 8 |
| Post-Operative Priority Visit Series | 42 | 18 |

## Notes to the schedules

- **Length of one appointment** is the scheduled length of one standing slot of that format, in minutes.
- **Standing appointments per week** is the range within which a series of that format is set up: the lower figure is the minimum standing appointments per week for the format and the higher figure the maximum.
- **Maximum series length** is counted in weeks from the series start date.
- **Booking horizon** is how far ahead appointments of the format may be booked, counted in calendar days from the booking date. **Maximum appointments in one booking** is the largest batch of appointments booked in a single booking.
- **Same weekday and time held** shows whether the series keeps one weekday and time slot for its whole length. Only the Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series does not hold a standing slot.

## Reading the schedules — illustrations (hypothetical)

- A Post-Operative Priority Visit Series is set up with no fewer than 2 and no more than 3 standing appointments a week, and may run up to 12 weeks from its start date; an Aquatic Therapy Visit Series runs at 1 or 2 a week for up to 6 weeks.
- An Aquatic Therapy Visit Series has the shortest booking horizon, 28 calendar days, and the smallest batch, 8 appointments, shared with the Specialty One-on-One Visit Series, whose horizon is the longest at 56 calendar days.
